name: Molara Ogundipe
shortBio: Nigerian feminist theorist, critic, and poet who coined Stiwanism (Social Transformation Including Women in Africa) to ground African women’s liberation in indigenous social structures rather than Western individualism.
centralQuestion: Why must African gender liberation pursue structural social transformation with African men rather than imitating Western liberal individualism?

keyWorks.title: Re-Creating Ourselves: African Women & Critical Transformations
keyWorks.description: Formulates Stiwanism and diagnoses the six mountains on the back of the African woman under colonialism and patriarchy.
